description: This file is a shell script used for testing git's conversion filters with large files. It sets up various test cases to verify the behavior of filters with different configurations such as autocrlf, eol, ident, custom filters, and checks handling of large files.

methods.name: set_attr
methods.description: Sets attributes for git filters; writes attribute settings to .gitattributes based on parameters.

methods.name: check_input
methods.description: Checks the input files with git read-tree, add, cat-file, and comparisons to verify filters on input.

methods.name: check_output
methods.description: Checks the output files after checkout with similar git commands and comparisons to verify filters on output.
